rulesTestNames: lists door rows and journal entries for one covered function
read: get and list (query naming programId and functionId) where a door duty covers the function, and the programme owner, while not deleted
write: server only; written from programDoorJournal, programGuests and programStaffGrants
migrationNotes: The newest entries are read by an ordered query with a limit of 60. No actor account id and no device id: only the actor's label. An anonymized entry's view drops the name, note and label. The program-door-views copy-forward migration creates views for sources that predate the triggers and leaves views the triggers wrote alone.
